answer: The mechanism is called Ridge-Currency Decay Scoring. Each agent earns a live score reflecting forge-time contributions across verifiable transactions, where newer work counts most. The enforcement rule awards authority proportional to neighbor scores summed within two hops, but capped at one-tenth the node's own peak. Since sybil networks lack genuine accumulated copper, any cluster must spend disproportionate real effort just to reach the same authority floor a single honest identity holds.
